statement: As of 2025 Fall Creek Farm & Nursery had seven varieties under validation in southern Chile: SEKOYA Fiesta 'FC13-113', SEKOYA Crunch 'FC13-083', SEKOYA Grande 'FC13-122', SEKOYA Pop 'FCM14-052', ArabellaBlue 'FC14-062', LunaBlue 'FC12-205' and LoretoBlue 'FC11-118', with 'FC15-173', 'FC16-003' and 'FC11-164' listed as selections still in development.
